fixes.explanation: Names? I get it, baker, a name feels like something worth keeping. But God says the seven pairs of birds are there “…to preserve their offspring on the face of all the earth.” (Genesis 7:3) Offspring means the young ones that come after. That's the word that fills the blank, friend.

Baked just right on this one, baker! The water comes from BELOW and from ABOVE. Verse 11 says, “…all the fountains of the great deep burst forth, and the floodgates of the heavens were opened.” Bursting fountains and open floodgates, friend, that is water coming from every direction at once. Then the waters keep rising until they cover the mountaintops (Genesis 7:19, 20).

problems.problem: The name-tag joke puts a made-up modern scenario at the ark door, blending it with the Bible setting.
The explanation is a straightforward recap with none of Papa Dorin’s personality. It reads flat.
